meta.name: apex-plan
meta.description: Plan and scope a project — discovery, challenge assumptions, present S/M/L options with token and cost estimates. Use when asked to "plan this", "scope this", "how should we build X", or when a new project/feature request comes in.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划项目范围并提供方案选项与成本估算
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为项目确定范围和成本
copy.tagline_en: Plan project scope and provide options with cost estimates
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to define project scope and estimate costs

howto.what: 安装后，Claude会先通过追问理解问题本质，挑战假设，然后评估需要的专家类型，给出小、中、大三种方案及其预估token和成本，等待用户选择后再分派专家执行，最后汇总结果和用量报告。
howto.when: 当你说“规划这个”、“界定范围”、“如何构建X”或提出新项目/功能需求时触发。

say.text: 请评估这个功能开发的规模和成本。
say.note: Claude会进行发现和选项分析。

say.text: 我需要你界定这个需求的范围。
say.note: Claude会挑战假设并给出S/M/L方案。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will first ask clarifying questions to understand the real problem, challenge assumptions, assess required specialists, present S/M/L options with token and cost estimates, wait for user choice, then dispatch specialists and deliver a unified result with usage receipt.
howto.when_en: When you ask to "plan this", "scope this", "how should we build X", or request a new project/feature.

say_en.text: Plan this new project for me.
say_en.note: Claude will start the planning process.

say_en.text: Estimate the size and cost of this feature.
say_en.note: Claude will perform discovery and option analysis.

say_en.text: I need you to scope this requirement.
say_en.note: Claude will challenge assumptions and present S/M/L options.
